name: Elena Rossi
message: The lift was out of order for three days and we were on teh 9th floor with a baby. We want compensation. Thanks, Elena
reply: Dear Elena, I'm sorry about the lift being out of order for three days. That must have been very hard with a baby on the 9th floor. I can't decide on compensation myself, so I've passed your request to a member of staff. They will reply to you by e-mail at elena.rossi@example.com.
summary: Guest Elena Rossi requests compensation: lift out of order for three days while staying on 9th floor with a baby.

name: Tom Becker
message: We arrive on the 20th. Is breakfast included in our booking? And can we still cancel if our plans change?
reply:
Hello Tom. Your booking is a Suite from 20 to 22 November 2026, and it doesn't include breakfast. Our buffet runs from 07:00 to 10:30. It costs €12 per person per day if you add it to your booking in advance, or €14 if you add it at check-in. Children under 6 eat free.

Your booking is on the non-refundable rate, which is already paid. It can't be refunded if you cancel or don't show up. You can move the stay once to new dates within 6 months, subject to availability, for a €25 change fee.
summary: Guest asks if breakfast is included and if cancellation is possible; booking is non-refundable, no breakfast, arrival 20 Nov 2026.
